concerns.location: plan.md:Functional Requirement Coverage table, FR-001 row
concerns.text: FR-001 (download experimental TOF dataset) is marked ⚠️ Pending – scope revision. The spec requires the system to download the open experimental TOF dataset; the plan substitutes a surrogate DFT activation barrier without a concrete plan to obtain the required TOF data, leaving FR-001 unfulfilled.

concerns.location: plan.md:Functional Requirement Coverage table, FR-008 row
concerns.text: FR-008 in the spec mandates significance only when p < 0.05 **and** ΔMAE ≥ 0.1 log‑TOF. The plan instead uses a combined rule of p < 0.05 **and** ΔR² ≥ 0.02, which does not satisfy the FR‑008 definition and therefore leaves FR‑008 inadequately addressed.
